title: Universal Shooter ESP & Aimbot | Open Source, No Key
features:
Universal ESP and aim assist for Roblox shooters. It is not written for one game - it reads the players in whatever shooter you are in, so it works in games that have no script of their own yet.

FEATURES
ESP - box, name, distance, health bar, tracer, head dot, and a "visible only" mode that hides anyone standing behind a wall
Aim assist - FOV circle, head / torso / closest target, sticky target, and it never pulls onto a player through a wall
Automatic team detection - your own team is skipped without you setting anything up
Automatic hitbox detection - it finds the aim parts the game itself uses instead of guessing at HumanoidRootPart
Humanisation - reaction time, wind up, jitter, dead zone and a degrees-per-second cap, with Legit / Normal / Raw presets
Panic key - F1 switches everything off at once

WHAT IT IS NOT
This does not replace a script written for one specific game and it is not pretending to. It is the fallback for games that do not have one yet. The same line loads the game-specific script by itself when there is one for the place you are in.

Works on mobile executors. The panel asks PC or phone on first run and scales itself, in four languages.

HOW TO RUN
1. Copy the script, execute it, press RightShift for the panel
2. ESP is on by default. Aim assist is off - switch it on and hold right mouse button

No key, no ads, and it never spends Robux.
Open source: https://github.com/seltonmt012/sel01-rbx/blob/main/games/universal.lua
